metadata.question: In 2003, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Queensland, Australia record a higher maximum daytime land surface temperature compared to Lut Desert, Iran and El Azizia, Libya?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS/061/MOD11A1 (daily LST, 1 km, daytime “LST_Day_1km” band). - Time: 2003-01-01 to 2003-12-31. - Locations: – Queensland, Australia: rough bbox [138–153 °E, ‑29.5 to ‑10 °S] (kept small but still thousands of pixels). – Lut Desert, Iran: rough bbox [54–60 °E, 28–34 °N]. – El Azizia, Libya: rough bbox [12–14 °E, 31–33 °N]. 2. Masking strategy: use the QC band (“QC_Day”) to keep only “good-quality” pixels (flag 0 and 1; discard 2,3) → mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(1)). 3. Calculation: for each region compute the 99.9th percentile of the year (avoids outliers while still capturing true max) of the daytime LST band. Compare Queensland 2003 max vs. max(Lut, El-Azizia). If any collection is empty → C1; if after masking the valid-pixel count is zero → C2; if None/NaN → C3; otherwise “Yes” (A) if Queensland’s max is strictly higher, else “No” (B). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1) Regions (small rectangles to stay within quota/time) qld = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([138, -29.5, 153, -10]) # Queensland lut = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([54, 28, 60, 34]) # Lut Desert aza = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([12, 31, 14, 33]) # El Azizia # 2) Load MODIS LST daily for 2003 col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')\ .filterDate('2003-01-01', '2003-12-31')\ .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']) nTot = col.size().getInfo() if nTot == 0: print("No images C1") print("C1") exit() # 3) Masking: keep QA flags 0 and 1 (good quality) def maskLST(img): qa = img.select('QC_Day') mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(1)) return img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()).updateMask(mask) col = col.map(maskLST) # 4) 99.9th percentile per region def getMax(geom, name): im = col.filterBounds(geom) if im.size().getInfo() == 0: print(f"No imgs {name} C1") print("C1") exit() pctl = im.reduce(ee.Reducer.percentile([99.9])).clip(geom) count = pctl.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km_p99_9').getInfo() val = pctl.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km_p99_9').getInfo() if count is None or val is None or count == 0: print(f"No valid pix {name} C2") print("C2") exit() print(f"{name}: {val:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(count)}") return val qldMax = getMax(qld, "Queensland") lutMax = getMax(lut, "Lut") azaMax = getMax(aza, "ElAzizia") if qldMax is None or lutMax is None or azaMax is None: print("Calc failed C3") print("C3") elif qldMax > max(lutMax, azaMax): print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1) Regions (small rectangles to stay within quota/time)
qld = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([138, -29.5, 153, -10])      # Queensland
lut = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([54, 28, 60, 34])            # Lut Desert
aza = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([12, 31, 14, 33])            # El Azizia

# 2) Load MODIS LST daily for 2003
col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1')\
        .filterDate('2003-01-01', '2003-12-31')\
        .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'])

nTot = col.size().getInfo()
if nTot == 0:
    print("No images C1")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3) Masking: keep QA flags 0 and 1 (good quality)
def maskLST(img):
    qa = img.select('QC_Day')
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0).Or(qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(1))
    return img.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames()).updateMask(mask)

col = col.map(maskLST)

# 4) 99.9th percentile per region
def getMax(geom, name):
    im = col.filterBounds(geom)
    if im.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print(f"No imgs {name} C1")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    pctl = im.reduce(ee.Reducer.percentile([99.9])).clip(geom)
    count = pctl.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km_p99_9').getInfo()
    val = pctl.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km_p99_9').getInfo()
    if count is None or val is None or count == 0:
        print(f"No valid pix {name} C2")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        exit()
    print(f"{name}: {val:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(count)}")
    return val

qldMax = getMax(qld, "Queensland")
lutMax = getMax(lut, "Lut")
azaMax = getMax(aza, "ElAzizia")

if qldMax is None or lutMax is None or azaMax is None:
    print("Calc failed C3")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif qldMax > max(lutMax, azaMax):
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
